thread:
Sam L.: Hey team — trying to land my first PR and hitting a couple of setup snags. CONTRIBUTING.md mentions `make integration` but it fails locally with a redis connection error. Where do folks usually run the full integration tests? Who should I ping for a review on infra-ish changes?

Mira R.: Welcome Sam! For day-to-day PRs we run the quick suite locally: `./dev/run_tests.sh --fast`. The full integration suite runs in CI (so you usually rely on that). If you need to reproduce the full environment locally, use `./dev/run_k8s_integration.sh` but note it requires docker-in-docker + >=16GB RAM.

Sam L.: When I run `make test` I see: `ConnectionRefusedError: [Errno 111] redis`. Any quick fixes?

Olivia C.: That typically means the test fixtures (redis/postgres) aren't up. Either run `docker-compose -f docker/dev.yml up redis postgres` or run `./dev/setup_fixtures.sh`. Also check `nvm use` — we standardize on node 18 for local tools.

Jon P.: Also remember pre-commit hooks will block the PR merge. Run `pre-commit run --all-files` before pushing to avoid surprise failures in CI.

Sam L.: Good call. CI queued a build earlier but it failed on linting, not tests. Is there a linter config I should grab?

Mira R.: Lint config is at `/tools/eslint/.eslintrc.js` and we have a small prettier wrapper in `package.json` scripts. Run `npm run lint:fix` or `yarn lint:fix`. If it's Python linting, run `tox -e lint` (or `nox -s lint` depending on your setup).

Sam L.: Who do I request review from for infra changes? Not sure about who owns the infra CODEOWNERS.

Olivia C.: For infra changes tag `@eng-platform` and ping Jon (he's on platform). Small non-breaking doc/typo stuff just needs one reviewer; infra/config changes usually need 2 reviewers and an ops ack. Check `CODEOWNERS` for the precise path owners.

Sam L.: Quick question about branch naming too — do we use `feature/` or `feat/` prefixes?

Jon P.: We prefer `feat/<ticket>-short-desc` for features and `fix/<ticket>` for bugfixes. For experiments use `wip/` until you want a review. Keep branch names < 50 chars if possible.

Sam L.: Thanks all — I'll try the docker-compose path, run pre-commit and lint, rename my branch to `feat/1234-first-run` and re-push. I'll ping `@eng-platform` + Jon for review when CI is green. :thumbsup:

Mira R.: If you want I can pair for 15 minutes to get your environment green. Ping me and we can screenshare.

Sam L.: That would be awesome — pinging you now. Thanks!
